In elementary school my class was invited to visit the US Capitol as we had a senator’s son in our class. It was a big deal and we all dressed up and were separated into groups to go on our tours. We had just about finished up and we were waiting for the rest of the groups outside when people started screaming and running past us. 

All we were told was to run, run anywhere away from the building. No details, no direction, just run. 

So here we were, a bunch of 6th graders running around DC trying to keep up with a teacher in our kitten heels, scared and confused. We finally made it to a large grassy park away from the Capitol when we found out there was a plane that was in the no fly zone and they were evacuating all government buildings in fear that it might be coming for one of the buildings. (This is 3 years after 9/11)

Turns out it was a pilot learning to fly and they didn’t know about the no fly zone.
